subject: Urgent Reorder: Fine Granulated Sugar for Week 42
text:
Dear Mr. Schmidt,

With reference to our framework agreement and due to an unexpectedly high order volume for our 'Sea Salt Edition', we are forced to adjust our raw material planning at short notice.

We urgently require an additional delivery of 2 tons of granulated sugar (fine), which must arrive at our goods receiving department by next Tuesday at the latest. Could you please check the feasibility of this unscheduled delivery as soon as possible?

We would be very grateful for a brief confirmation of the delivery date.

Best regards,

Your Purchasing Team

subject: Important Information: Maintenance Work on Cooking Kettle 3
text:
Dear colleagues in Production,

Please note the following change in the operational process: Next Friday, starting at 14:00, necessary technical maintenance (descaling and seal inspection) will be carried out on Cooking Kettle 3.

This means that the system will not be available for the remainder of the late shift. I therefore ask you to adjust the shift planning accordingly to avoid a backlog in the processing of the cream caramel mass.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

Best regards,

Technical Management

subject: Feedback on Christmas Edition Designs / Material Testing
text:
Good afternoon Ms. Weber,

I have carefully reviewed the current design drafts for the Christmas Edition. Basically, the design is very appealing; however, there are technical concerns regarding feasibility.

The gold finish looks excellent in the digital view, but the practical test with the prototype sample has shown that the paint flakes off at the edges as soon as the candy is twisted. This does not meet our quality standards for premium products.

I suggest that we meet soon to discuss alternative materials or printing processes.

Best regards,

Product Management

subject: Complaint: Transport Damage Shipment #4920
text:
Dear Mr. Weber,

Regrettably, we must inform you that shipment #4920 (Butterfudge Cubes) arrived today at our warehouse in Hamburg in an unacceptable condition.

After initial assessment, it appears that the cold chain was massively interrupted during transport. The goods have completely melted into a single block and are therefore unsellable. You will find detailed photo documentation of the damage attached to this email.

We request a statement on the matter as soon as possible, as well as proposals for further handling of the insurance claim.

Best regards,

Logistics Department

subject: Invitation to Internal Tasting: New 'Chili-Mango' Product Line
text:
Dear Employees,

The Product Development department is pleased to present the results of the past few weeks to you. We have been working on a new, exotic flavor: 'Chili-Mango'.

To finalise the recipe, we rely on your valued opinion. Starting at 12:00, we will provide samples for blind tasting in the central break room.

We specifically ask for feedback on the balance between the sweetness of the fruit and the spiciness of the chili. You can note your feedback directly on site on the questionnaires provided.

We look forward to your active participation.

Best regards,

Your Development Team

subject: Payment Release: Invoice Vanilla Extract (Organic)
text:
Good morning Mr. Müller,

Attached I am sending you the current invoice from our supplier in Madagascar for the last delivery of organic vanilla extract.

I have checked the goods receipt and the delivery is complete and flawless. Please arrange for payment on a priority basis so that we can take advantage of the early payment discount. Given the currently rising raw material prices for real vanilla, it is important to secure our good terms.

Thank you for your support.

Best regards,

Raw Material Purchasing

subject: Offer: Autumn Promotion and Secondary Placement
text:
Dear Ms. Müller,

Thank you for the pleasant telephone conversation yesterday. As discussed, please find attached our detailed offer for the upcoming autumn promotion.

We propose a secondary placement of our soft caramels in your branches, supported by our new 'Vintage-Look' display stands. Initial test markets have shown that this design significantly increases impulse purchases.

The detailed conditions as well as the dimensions of the stands can be found in the attached PDF document. I am available for any questions at any time.

Best regards,

Key Account Management

subject: Critical Temperature Rise in Warehouse B
text:
Hello Mr. Bauer,

I must point out an urgent problem in Warehouse B. The temperature sensors have been reporting a constant value of 24 degrees Celsius for an hour now.

For the unpackaged goods stored there, this temperature is too high. There is a risk that the caramel mass will lose its shape stability. Please immediately check the function of the air conditioning system and initiate emergency measures if necessary.

Please let me know as soon as the problem has been identified.

Best regards,

Warehouse Management

subject: Inquiry: Spare Part Procurement for Cutting Machine Type C
text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We require a spare part for the rope former of the 400 series for our production. Specifically, it is the cutting blade for the Type C cutting machine.

The blade currently installed is showing signs of wear, leading to unclean cut edges on our toffees. To ensure product quality, a short-term replacement is unavoidable.

Could you please let us know if you have this part in stock and send us a corresponding offer including delivery time?

Best regards,

Technical Purchasing

subject: Invitation to Job Interview and Trial Work
text:
Dear Mr. Klein,

Thank you for your application and interest in working for our company. Your documents, and especially your experience in processing sugar masses, appealed to us very much.

We would like to get to know you personally and hereby invite you to a job interview including a short period of trial work in our factory. We suggest next Wednesday at 10:00 for this.

Please let us know briefly if you can attend this appointment.

Best regards,

Human Resources Department

subject: Quality Deviation: Lab Report Batch 882 (Salted Caramel)
text:
Dear colleagues in Quality Assurance,

The analysis of Batch 882 ('Salted Caramel') from this morning has unfortunately revealed a deviation from the specification.

According to the laboratory report, the salt content is 1.8%, while our standard value is defined at 1.5%. We ask you to immediately carry out organoleptic testing on the retained samples to determine whether the goods are still within the flavor tolerance or must be blocked.

We expect your report by 14:00.

Best regards,

Laboratory Management

subject: Escalation: Customer Complaint Regarding Packaging Material
text:
Hello Customer Service Team,

I am forwarding a telephone complaint we received today. A customer reported that with the 'Cream Classic' bag (Expiry 12/2025), the wax paper can hardly be detached from the candy.

This could indicate a problem with the coating of the new paper delivery. Please record the case and compare the batch number with other complaints from the last week. If this accumulates, we must contact the supplier.

Please keep me informed.

Best regards,

Head of Quality Management

subject: Monthly Report October: Sales Development and Analysis
text:
Dear Management,

Please find attached the detailed sales report for the month of October. We are pleased to inform you that we have significantly exceeded the targets.

Thanks to the successful Halloween campaign, we were able to increase sales by 15% compared to the same period last year. Particularly noteworthy is the success of the black liquorice caramels, which were sold out early in several markets. A detailed breakdown by region can be found in the attachment.

We forecast stable development for the coming month of November.

Best regards,

Controlling Department

subject: Approval of Print Data: 500g Bag Back Side
text:
Dear Ms. Koch,

We have finally checked and approved the texts for the back of the new 500g bag. Please find the corresponding files attached.

We would like to ask you once again to pay special attention to the legibility of the nutrition table. Since the bag is made of flexible material and will crinkle, it must be ensured that the mandatory information remains clearly recognizable even when filled.

Please send us a final proof before starting the print.

Best regards,

Marketing & Communication

subject: Cleaning Order: Special Cleaning Production Area Mixing
text:
Good day,

Please plan an intensive wet cleaning in the mixing area for this evening after production ends.

Due to an incident this morning, a container of glucose syrup tipped over. Although the area was roughly cleaned, the floor still shows heavy sticky residue, which poses a safety risk. Machine cleaning is mandatory here.

Thank you for your fast support.

Best regards,

Production Shift Lead

subject: Incident Report: Connection Error Scale 4 / ERP System
text:
Dear IT Support Team,

We currently have a technical problem at packaging line 4. The checkweigher installed there has not been transmitting any weight data to the ERP system for about 30 minutes.

Since we are currently forced to carry out the logging manually, this significantly slows down the packaging process. Restarting the terminal unfortunately did not solve the problem.

We request urgent inspection and troubleshooting.

Best regards,

Production Management Packaging

subject: Need for Discussion: Price Adjustment Condensed Milk 2025
text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We confirm receipt of your letter regarding the planned price increase for condensed milk in the coming year.

As a long-standing partner and buyer of large quantities, we view the announced increase critically. In order to find a solution that is acceptable to both sides and to continue our cooperation, we would like to enter into negotiations again.

Would you be available for a discussion – by telephone or on site – next week?

Best regards,

Strategic Purchasing Management

subject: Content Suggestion: Video Production in the Casting Area
text:
Hello Social Media Team,

During my walk through production today, I noticed that the process of pouring the liquid caramel mass onto the cooling table is visually very appealing. This could be excellent for our channels (Instagram Reels / TikTok), perhaps under the theme 'Satisfying Process'.

Do you think it's possible to schedule a short filming session for tomorrow without disrupting ongoing operations? I could organize access to line 2 from 10:00 AM.

I look forward to your feedback.

Best regards,

Corporate Communications

subject: Coordination Meeting: Shift Plan for the Christmas Holidays
text:
Dear Members of the Works Council,

We are finalizing the personnel deployment planning for the upcoming Christmas holidays. Due to the continued high demand, it is economically necessary to maintain production on the holidays to a reduced extent.

We would like to submit a proposal for the shift staffing as well as the corresponding holiday bonuses and request a meeting soon for mutual coordination in order to create planning security for the workforce.

Best regards,

Human Resources Management

subject: Transmission of FDA Documents / Customs Clearance Shipment #NY-204
text:
Dear Mr. Fischer,

Following our previous correspondence, please find attached the required FDA documentation regarding the caramel shipment to New York (Reference #NY-204).

We have ensured that all ingredient lists and production certificates comply with current US import regulations. Please review the documents and confirm receipt at your earliest convenience, so we can authorize the release of the container.

Should you require any further information, do not hesitate to contact us.

Sincerely,

Export Department
